name: application-sticky-section-header
title: Sticky Section Header
description: Grouped list components with section headers that pin to the top of a scrollable container while their group scrolls beneath.
useWhen: Grouped list components with section headers that pin to the top of a scrollable container while their group scrolls beneath.
avoidWhen: Avoid sticky section header when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Sticky Section Header uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
